intro: Custom tattoo work in Los Angeles, built on nearly 20 years of experience. JP Han is the creator of HanScript — a new cyber sigilism based on Hangul, turning Korean letterforms into modern day energy marks.
about: JP Han is a Los Angeles–based tattoo artist working under the name JP.HAN TATTOO. Every piece starts as a conversation — your story, the placement, and the boundaries of the design — before it ever becomes a stencil.
hanscript: Most cyber sigilism is built on Sanskrit. HanScript is built on Hangul — Korean letterforms broken down, sharpened, and rebuilt into sigils that carry the energy of a word, a name, or an intention.
